fields.label: Full Name
fields.helpText: Your name as it should appear on your name badge.

fields.label: Email Address
fields.helpText: Your ticket and event details will be sent here.

fields.label: Phone Number
fields.helpText: Optional. We'll only contact you if there's a last-minute change.

fields.label: Which Session Are You Attending?
fields.helpText: Each session has limited capacity — first come, first served.

fields.label: Dietary Restrictions
fields.helpText: Lunch will be provided. Let us know about any requirements.

fields.label: I require accessibility accommodations
fields.helpText: Check this if you need wheelchair access, sign language interpretation, or other support.

fields.label: Please describe your accommodation needs
fields.helpText: Be as specific as possible so we can make the right arrangements.

thank_you.title: You're registered!
thank_you.body_md: Your spot is confirmed. Check your email for a ticket and calendar invite. We look forward to seeing you there — if anything changes, reach out and we'll do our best to accommodate you.
